importantNote: Universal Nordic Teal Gradient (#138086), wide squircle cards, and rich collection detail browsing for mobile & desktop.

changelog.category: Nordic Teal Theme & Mobile Engine Update (v2.0.0)
items: Enforced Nordic Teal radial gradient (#138086 -> #061A1C) across all mobile and desktop layouts.
Removed opaque black viewport overlays in mobile queries.
Fixed card sizing in horizontal shelves to prevent flex shrinking.
Clicking any album, playlist, artist mix, or chart opens full tracklist view before playing.
Bumped Service Worker cache to v128 to immediately purge stale mobile cache.
